intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Banaras Hindu University vs FMS BHU is not a contest between two unrelated campuses. FMS, the Institute of Management Studies at BHU, is the university's own management school.

sections.heading: Banaras Hindu University vs FMS BHU for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Banaras Hindu University if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #60, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹23 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Varanasi.
Choose FMS BHU if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #60, and a 2024 flagship package record of ₹12.1 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Varanasi.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Banaras Hindu University that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.
The official IM-BHU information bulletin for the 2026-28 MBA / MBA-IB batch lists a regular fee of ₹30,000 a semester, or ₹1.20 lakh across four semesters, excluding hostel.
Our recorded figure for FMS BHU is ₹1.2 lakh on MBA Finance. Check it against the official notice before you decide.
FMS, also called the Institute of Management Studies at Banaras Hindu University, is the university's own management school, so this is not a comparison of two unrelated campuses.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Banaras Hindu University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹23 LPA and a highest package of ₹120 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
FMS BHU's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹12.1 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2023 and 2024, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Banaras Hindu University is listed on our records with CAT, CUET PG as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
FMS BHU is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
The official IM-BHU 2026-28 bulletin says MBA and MBA-IB shortlists use CAT 2025, then a group discussion and interview, with a separate application on the BHU SAMARTH portal.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Banaras Hindu University is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded MBA / PGDM offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
FMS BHU is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded MBA / PGDM offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Banaras Hindu University or FMS BHU?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Banaras Hindu University and FMS BHU differ in more than one way: Banaras Hindu University holds NIRF 2025 #60 on our records, while FMS BHU holds NIRF 2025 #60.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Banaras Hindu University vs FMS BHU?
faqs.answer: we do not hold a quotable fee for Banaras Hindu University on this page; The official IM-BHU information bulletin for the 2026-28 MBA / MBA-IB batch lists a regular fee of ₹30,000 a semester, or ₹1.20 lakh across four semesters, excluding hostel.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Banaras Hindu University and FMS BHU?
faqs.answer: Banaras Hindu University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹23 LPA and a highest package of ₹120 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Banaras Hindu University and FMS BHU accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, CUET PG for Banaras Hindu University, and CAT for FMS BHU. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Banaras Hindu University and FMS BHU in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
